name: IB Psychology Prep: Psychwren
subtitle: IB Psychology SL/HL practice
shortDescription: Revise IB Psychology your way: adaptive quizzes, hands-on labs, research proposal builder and timed papers. Every topic of the 2027 guide, SL and HL marked.
longDescription:
Revise IB Psychology with a study plan that adapts to you. Psychwren covers the Diploma Programme Psychology guide for first assessment in 2027 at standard and higher level: the biological, cognitive and sociocultural approaches, research methodology, the four contexts (health and well-being, human development, human relationships, learning and cognition), the six concepts, and the HL extensions in culture, motivation and technology.

### How It Helps
- Adaptive practice: every quiz updates a mastery map. Wrong answers lead to the lesson and a short fix-it set, then the app picks your next best step.
- Two ways to study: follow the syllabus order, or switch to Real-World problems such as habits, memory for exams, first impressions and fair surveys.
- Hands-on labs: sampling, correlation, anchoring, descriptive statistics, conditioning curves and a synapse model.
- Builds: a research proposal studio with a live word count and a self-check for each internal assessment criterion, a data-tool checker, a class practical planner and an extended essay planner.
- Timed practice in the style of Paper 1, Paper 2 and (at HL) Paper 3.
- Other boards: see where each topic meets A Level, GCSE and AP content.
- Text size from 50% to 300%, built for phones and tablets, works offline.

### What You Get
Free: a large part of the course, including lessons, practice questions, three labs, the research proposal introduction and the data-tool checker.
Psychwren Plus: one monthly subscription unlocks the remaining topics, the harder labs, the full proposal studio, planners and timed papers. Cancel any time in your store account settings.

### Coverage
Every approach term, research-methodology term, context area and HL extension named in the guide tables is a topic with lessons and at least eight original questions, plus the concepts, paper formats, class practicals and the four internal assessment criteria. Study summaries are written in our own words. The app does not copy IB text, past papers or mark schemes.

### Important
Psychwren is an independent study aid. It is not produced, reviewed or endorsed by the International Baccalaureate Organization. Practice results do not predict a grade. Content about mental health is educational and is not medical advice.

A short notice appears on first opening. Optional usage information helps us improve the course and can be changed at any time under More, Privacy and data. Diagnostics and feedback are sent only when you tap Send.
